user_authorization: Run all Res combinations with BatchNorm and Dropout on the existing common folds

cv.selection: mean fold Macro AUC; exact tie then lower mean training seconds

neural.preprocessing: training-only median, numerical standardization and one-hot encoding

batchnorm.locations: after each hidden Linear, before ReLU and Dropout
batchnorm.evaluation: eval mode uses training running statistics

residual_connection.main_branch: Linear(128,64), optional BatchNorm, ReLU, optional Dropout
residual_connection.addition: after the second module activation and Dropout, before the final output Linear
residual_connection.main_initialization_and_dropout_rng: same seed 2026 and preserved RNG as corresponding non-residual models
residual_connection.scope: projected shortcut variant of a two-hidden-layer MLP

modules.backbone: CatBoost selected in the earlier seven-configuration comparison, fixed before the BatchNorm extension
modules.weight_constraints: nonnegative weights summing to one per outcome
modules.weight_training: minimize binary cross-entropy on three-fold inner OOF predictions inside each outer fitting partition
modules.parent_fusion_results: reuse the verified equal and task-specific CatBoost results on the same folds

evaluation.threshold_stage: selected configuration pooled OOF only, after model selection
evaluation.holdout_scope: same-source supplemental data previously evaluated in exploration

prior_result_awareness: Residual extension authorized after earlier CV, same-source and platform results were known.
